lines.en: My steps are slow, but the blade arrives first.

lines.zh: 锈水顺着刃口滴在土上。
lines.en: Rust water drips off my edge onto the dirt.
I do not chase; rust is already on your boots.

lines.zh: 刃气在草地上割出一道沟。
lines.en: The blade breath cuts a trench through the grass.

lines.zh: 每一步，我都在数你的护甲。
lines.en: Each step, I count the plates you wear.
My blade drags the ground, a sound like grinding teeth.

lines.zh: 灾区不需要快，只需要到。
lines.en: A disaster need not be quick, only arrive.
I walk steadier than a pendulum.
I remember the road to the village ahead.

lines.zh: 锈在我走过的地上蔓延。
lines.en: Rust spreads across the ground behind my steps.
Slower, so the fear arrives before me.

lines.zh: 刀口在等一个薄甲的人。
lines.en: My edge waits for someone thin on armor.
Twice the pause, long enough to regret.

lines.zh: 刀停在半空，我在算角度。
lines.en: The blade hangs midair while I measure angles.

lines.zh: 这身重甲让我不急着动。
lines.en: This heavy plate leaves me in no hurry.
Corrosion smells better to me than blood.

lines.zh: 我在听金属被啃的声音。
lines.en: I listen to metal being eaten away.
Who stands there, and how many armor points?

lines.zh: 风把我的锈粉吹向村子。
lines.en: The wind carries my rust dust toward the village.
No rush; disasters live long.

lines.zh: 刀上那层绿，是别人的甲。
lines.en: That green on my blade was someone else's armor.
I count the swings I have left.
That iron on your chest is too thin.
Look up at me, not at my blade.
I am measuring the seams on your shoulder.
Your armor rattles louder than your heart.
That face is worth one corroding slash.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我看得见睫毛抖。
lines.en: Do not blink; I see your lashes tremble.
Half a step back and your armor shows a gap.
Good eyes; they make a fine target.

lines.zh: 这种眼神，是准备跑的眼神。
lines.en: That look is the one that means running.
Watch my blade; it moves before I do.
Pain? My armor feels it for me.
That did not even scratch the rust.
You hit iron; do not gloat.
Two hundred points of life; grind away.
My blade is still here, so I have not lost.
My blood is sour; it splashes your face.
The more you hurry, the truer I swing.
This wound buys me one more swing.

lines.zh: 别停手，我正算你的空隙。
lines.en: Do not stop; I am measuring your gaps.
After the pain, the blade feels heavier.

lines.zh: 食物？我只对铁锈有胃口。
lines.en: Food? Only rust has any taste for me.

lines.zh: 收起来，我不吃活人的东西。
lines.en: Put it away; I do not eat what the living eat.

lines.zh: 你举着它，像在喂一把刀。
lines.en: You hold it up as if feeding a blade.
I am not hungry; I just want something to cut.
Bread will not stop a single swing.

lines.zh: 拿远点，我的锈会弄脏它。
lines.en: Move it away; my rust will spoil it.

lines.zh: 灾厄的胃，装着别人的甲片。
lines.en: My stomach holds plates taken off the dead.

lines.zh: 这味道太干净，我不喜欢。
lines.en: That smell is too clean for my liking.

lines.zh: 我不为吃停下，只为砍停下。
lines.en: I stop to cut, never to eat.
Keep it; do not choke on it while running.

lines.zh: 撞上来？我的甲比你的硬。
lines.en: Bump into me? My plate is harder than yours.

lines.zh: 这点推力，推不动两百斤的灾。
lines.en: That shove will not move two hundred pounds of disaster.
You struck two hundred pounds of rusted plate.

lines.zh: 让开，我的刀正找地方落。
lines.en: Step aside; my blade is looking for a place to land.

lines.zh: 别贴太近，锈会爬到你甲上。
lines.en: Do not press close; rust climbs onto armor.

lines.zh: 退开，我不喜欢被人挡道。
lines.en: Back off; I dislike being blocked.

lines.zh: 你肩膀撞歪了，我的没歪。
lines.en: Your shoulder is crooked now; mine is not.
Those who shove in lose armor points first.
That bump counts as you sharpening me.

lines.zh: 别碰我，刀口会自己找路。
lines.en: Do not touch me; the edge finds its own way.
Disasters do not breed; they spread.

lines.zh: 我的同族都从土里锈出来。
lines.en: My kin rust their way out of the soil.

lines.zh: 没有伴侣，只有下一把刀。
lines.en: No partner, only the next blade.

lines.zh: 两把刀碰一起，只会缺角。
lines.en: Two blades meeting only chip each other.
I need no one to lift my blade.

lines.zh: 锈会传下去，这就算后代。
lines.en: Rust passes on; that is offspring enough.

lines.zh: 这身甲是捡的，不是传的。
lines.en: This armor was taken, not handed down.

lines.zh: 战场上没有成双的灾厄。
lines.en: Disasters do not come in pairs on a battlefield.
Do not ask such things; my blade will answer.
My blood is sour; it nourishes no one.
This plate will patch my shoulder nicely.
I pick things up only to whet my edge.
The iron is mine; you are the soil's.
My hilt is loose; I will take that wood.
This shield will stop three swings.
Everything I take comes away rusted.
Leave it; that is my spoil.
Good cloth; it will wrap my grip.
Every fallen armor scrap belongs to me.
Iron is the only thing I can carry.

lines.zh: 护甲不满十，就是给我开门。
lines.en: Under ten armor points is a door left open for me.
You. Stand still and take the armor off.

lines.zh: 我闻到你肩上的铁味了。
lines.en: I smell the iron on your shoulders.
Stop looking around; I chose you.
The thinly armored taste the corroding slash first.

lines.zh: 你身上那层皮，挡不住锈。
lines.en: That hide of yours will not stop rust.

lines.zh: 我看见你腰上缺了一块。
lines.en: I see a gap at your waist.
Run; I enjoy chasing thin armor.

lines.zh: 刀抬起来了，你还有两步。
lines.en: The blade is up; you have two steps left.
Two hundred pounds of disaster has picked you.

lines.zh: 你的甲缝在响，我听见了。
lines.en: Your armor seams creak; I hear them.
Drop the shield first, then we talk.
I am slow, but I walk one road only.
Do not call your friends; their armor is thinner.
There is an old seam in your armor.

lines.zh: 再退一步，刃就落在脖子。
lines.en: One more step back and the edge finds your neck.
I count to three, then your plate splits.
Do not watch the blade; watch my feet.
You hold that shield like the last one did.
The rust is already climbing your bracer.
I have waited twice as long for this swing.
Keep your breathing steady; panic speeds me up.
The thinly armored always back away.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖在抖，甲也在抖。
lines.en: Your knees tremble, and so does your armor.
The corroding slash takes armor, not bone.
Stand still; running makes it harder for you.

lines.zh: 我在等你最后一点甲掉。
lines.en: I am waiting for your last armor point to fall.
The tip is on you; do not fidget.
This swing takes me four full seconds.

lines.zh: 我走直线，你也只能直线跑。
lines.en: I walk straight, and you can only run straight.
You switch shields, and I switch targets.
The iron dust on the ground is yours.
Finish strapping up, then I will come.
Corroding slash: armor breaks first, then the man.

lines.zh: 三十五点，够你记一辈子。
lines.en: Thirty-five points; enough to remember forever.
I will take that chestplate now.
Rust is seeping into the seams. Does it hurt?
A slow blade lands truest.
Do not block; the armor will not survive either.
That one shaved off half your iron.

lines.zh: 你的盾裂了，声音真好听。
lines.en: Your shield cracked; what a pleasant sound.
The blade returns wearing your paint.

lines.zh: 我倒要看看几刀剥光你。
lines.en: Let us see how many swings strip you bare.

lines.zh: 站直，我砍歪了还得再来。
lines.en: Stand straight; a miss means another swing.

lines.zh: 血是热的，甲是冷的，都归我。
lines.en: Blood is warm, armor is cold; both are mine.
Do not thank me; it was no trouble.

lines.zh: 你的甲点掉得比心跳快。
lines.en: Your armor drops faster than your pulse.
This cut goes in at the shoulder seam.
The plate is off, and your hand still shakes.
The soil splits, and rust comes up first.
A disaster stands up out of the field.

lines.zh: 两倍的间隔，从这一刻算。
lines.en: Twice the interval starts from this moment.
The blade wakes first; then I do.
The grass here has the wrong color now.
I arrive carrying two hundred points of life.

lines.zh: 谁在这片地上留了脚印？
lines.en: Who left footprints on this ground?

lines.zh: 锈味飘出去，村里会知道。
lines.en: The rust smell travels; the village will know.

lines.zh: 甲在肩上，刀在手里，齐了。
lines.en: Armor on, blade in hand; that is all.

lines.zh: 我走了很久，才走到这里。
lines.en: I walked a long way to stand here.
Do not run yet; watch me raise the blade.
This stretch of land belongs to disaster now.
Fire cannot dry out my rust.
Falling from height, my armor takes the landing.
Rust in water only spreads faster.
The shattered iron flies; I will keep it.

lines.zh: 箭卡在甲缝里，拔出来还你。
lines.en: The arrow is stuck in my seam; I will return it.
Magic gnaws hide, not iron.
I do not eat meals; I eat armor.

lines.zh: 雷落在刀上，算替我开锋。
lines.en: Lightning on my blade counts as sharpening.
Even the void is not as empty as rust.
